content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement with me. Before proceeding, I would like to request a couple of adjustments: - The agreement assigns all rights in the work product immediately upon creation without making the transfer conditional on receiving full payment; I propose modifying this so that upon receipt of full payment, ownership of the Deliverables shall transfer to the Client. - Ownership of the work passes to the client upon creation rather than upon full payment, meaning rights to the work are lost before payment is received; I propose that ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid all fees due under this Agreement, at which point ownership shall transfer to the Client. Thank you for your cooperation.
